title: Rundfunkbeitrag in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **It is charged on the flat, not on you.** One Wohnung owes **18.36 euro a month**, **220.32 euro a year**, no matter how many people live there and no matter what devices they own. The figure has stood since August 2021.

**That rule bites hardest in Berlin.** The 2025 Mikrozensus counted about **1.95 million households** here and **977,000 of them hold one person**, half the city. In Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg it is **59.2 per cent**. A per flat fee is a per person fee for half of Berlin.

**Four ways Berliners pay twice:** a second account kept behind one flat door, the flat you moved out of and never deregistered, a second home that was never applied for, and a hall room that is genuinely its own Wohnung being paid for on top of a WG account.

**Exemption is by benefit, never automatic.** Grundsicherungsgeld, Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt, Grundsicherung im Alter and **BAfoeG when you do not live with your parents** all qualify on application. **Arbeitslosengeld I, Wohngeld and Uebergangsgeld do not.** The RF mark gives a reduced **6.12 euro**.

**A second home is released only on application.** The right has existed since **1 June 2020**, it needs proof that you pay for your main home, and it starts from the month the application arrives or up to three months earlier.

**Ignoring the letters is the expensive option.** Registration records are compared nationwide, and an unanswered letter turns into a Festsetzungsbescheid, which is an enforceable title on its own without a court.
